fullPassage: Although the development of smiling and laughter is similar across cultures, the behaviors that parents use to elicit smiling do vary. For example, American mothers rely largely on toys and objects to elicit smiling from their infants, whereas Japanese mothers are likely to engage infants in social stimulation. Mothers in both cultures are equally effective in eliciting these smiles, but they do it in different ways (using toys versus using touch or physical contact) because of different culture-based parenting goals. In the United States, mothers place high value on promoting autonomy and independent exploration of the object world. Japanese mothers, by contrast, place high value on strengthening mutual dependency and making the infant an extension of themselves. Thus, they engage their infants differently.

det.korean: ④ unequally(불평등하게) → equally(똑같이): 'Mothers in both cultures are ___ effective in eliciting these smiles, but they do it in different ways' — 방식은 달라도 결과(웃음 유도 효과)는 '똑같이(equally)' 효과적이라는 대비 구조. unequally는 정반대 의미로 논리 붕괴.

✅ ③ mutual: 원문 일치 ('상호' 의존 강화 — Japanese mothers 특성)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 제목: 'Same Smile, Different Paths Across Cultures' — 웃음이라는 보편적 결과는 같지만, 문화가 그 경로(방식+목표)를 달리 만든다는 본문 핵심 대비.
